title: IELTS Speaking · Đề luyện tập NL-1
source: Đề tự soạn bởi NihongoLife theo định dạng IELTS Speaking (3 phần)

groups.heading: PART 1 · Introduction and interview
groups.instruction: The examiner asks about familiar topics. Answer each question in 2-4 sentences (up to 40 seconds).

items.text: Let's talk about where you live. Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What do you like most about your neighbourhood?
Now let's talk about learning languages. How often do you practise a foreign language?
Do you prefer learning with an app or with a teacher? Why?

groups.heading: PART 2 · Long turn
groups.instruction: You have one minute to prepare (you may make notes), then speak for one to two minutes.
groups.stem: Describe a time when you learned something useful outside school.

lines.text: where and how you learned it
and explain why it was useful to you.

items.text: Describe a time when you learned something useful outside school.

groups.heading: PART 3 · Discussion
groups.instruction: Discuss more abstract ideas linked to Part 2. Give extended answers with reasons and examples (up to 75 seconds).

items.text: Why do some adults find it difficult to learn new skills?
Do you think video games can teach useful real-world skills? Why or why not?
How might the way people learn change in the next twenty years?
